global_read: Global tape per global.json (11:27 snapshot, already reflects today's escalation): Brent $84.73 (+1.72% 1d, 4-week high), WTI $79.62 (+1.89% 1d), VIX 17.16 (+14.17% 1d, sharpest jump in the desk's tracked window), gold +0.98% (safe-haven bid), S&P/Dow only modestly negative (-0.79%/-0.26%), PKR/USD 277.8 (+0.34% 1d, still orderly not disorderly), DXY flat/soft. This is a textbook energy-and-fear shock signature (oil + VIX + gold all up together while broad equities have not yet cracked) — global developed-market risk appetite is cracking only modestly, but the shock is landing directly and disproportionately on Pakistan via the oil-import channel, which is the opposite of a benign global backdrop for PSX today.
drivers: ESCALATION CONFIRMED THIS CYCLE: President Trump announced Monday 2026-07-13 that the US is reinstating a naval blockade of Iranian shipping through the Strait of Hormuz, effective Tuesday 2026-07-14 at 4pm, plus a 20% US 'reimbursement' fee on all other cargo transiting the strait, styling the US as the waterway's 'guardian' — this directly matches and confirms the news-sentinel's impact-5 trigger for this cycle (https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-13/trump-says-us-will-be-reimbursed-20-rate-for-hormuz-traffic, https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/13/trump-iran-hormuz-strait-charge-reimburse.html, https://www.usnews.com/news/world/articles/2026-07-13/trump-says-the-us-will-control-strait-of-hormuz-and-get-paid-for-it)

REGIME CALL: risk-off (escalated conviction vs yesterday's already risk-off call). Rationale — (1) the geopolitical shock that triggered yesterday's call has hardened further today into an actual announced blockade + punitive cargo fee on the exact chokepoint Pakistan depends on for >80% of crude imports; (2) this is now confirmed in both the global tape (oil at 4-week highs, VIX sharply up) and PSX's own live price action (a second consecutive down day, today intraday worse than yesterday at roughly -2%); (3) the desk's own georisk radar independently jumped from 47 to 60/100 on this same news; (4) domestic anchors (SBP hold, easing CPI, on-track IMF program, stable reserves, easing T-bill/PIB yields) remain genuinely constructive and argue against a deeper/panic-level risk-off, but they are backward-looking relative to a shock that is intensifying in real time. Net: stay risk-off, defensive/beneficiary sectors only, max 2 new setups per desk rules.
